scope: Recorded web-research smoke test for source accessibility and fallback behavior; not a complete itinerary or booking test.

sources.fact_checked: The parking POI and general location are discoverable.
sources.verdict: Usable for POI discovery, but the full interactive route requires JavaScript and must not be treated as fully verified by a text-only agent.

sources.fact_checked: Family restaurant listings and review discovery are searchable.
sources.verdict: Useful as one review source; detailed negative-review analysis still requires page-level access or a second provider.
Robots restrictions can block retrieval, so the Agent must switch to Tripadvisor, Google reviews, or direct restaurant sources.

sources.fact_checked: Parking and laundry claims can be discovered for hotel candidates near the park.
sources.verdict: Suitable for candidate research only; current price, cancellation, parking operation, laundry details, and availability require date-specific and direct-property confirmation.

sources.fact_checked: An official point-forecast endpoint exists for Yosemite Valley, but current forecast content was not reliably retrievable in the recheck.
sources.verdict: Keep NWS as the official weather authority, record the stale or unavailable result, and require a dated recheck instead of asserting a current forecast.

sources.fact_checked: Current conditions, road status, reservations, and park alerts are published by the official park authority.
sources.verdict: Must take precedence over community posts and commercial listings for closures and entry policy.

sources.fact_checked: Tour inventory, duration, pickup, and displayed pricing are discoverable.
sources.verdict: Useful for comparison only; official access rules and seller terms must be checked separately.

limitations: No transaction, login, booking, cancellation, or payment was attempted.
No mobile-app navigation or live traffic route was executed.
This run validates source routing and fallback behavior, not end-to-end itinerary quality on every host.
